    METHODS = ("type4", "lastweek", "week7", "typical")

    def __init__(self, ds: D.Dataset, method: str = "type4", k: int = 4,
                 lookback: int = 30):

            raise ValueError(method)

            return self.ds.typical.price.copy()      # 仅预热期第一天，不入交付
        if self.method == "typical":                 # 泄露基准，仅作对照
            return self.ds.typical.price.copy()
        if self.method == "lastweek" and i >= 7:
            return self.P[i - 7].copy()
        if self.method == "week7":
            return self.P[max(0, i - 7):i].mean(axis=0)
        # type4：近 k 个同日型
